pos.personaBrief: Boot Room concluded on a more possession-oriented approach (LFC 2026) and a 4-4-2 with the accent on passing, yet also fast counters in three or four passes; the 'right ball' view means possession is a tool, not a creed.

pro.personaBrief: Paisley: learn to be patient breaking out of defence, think two or three moves ahead (Tomkins); ball-playing centre-backs Hansen and Lawrenson; but quick counters after winning the ball (Neal-Kennedy-McDermott).

est.personaBrief: Blocks moved in territorial unison, but Neal overlapped with cover and Dalglish floated between midfield and attack as a 4-4-1-1; Paisley said Liverpool's players were not produced to one rigid template.

lar.personaBrief: After Dalglish, a 4-4-2 with passing accent and no classic wingers; central creators like McDermott, Souness and Dalglish drove play, with overlapping full-back Neal.

blo.personaBrief: Compact lines moving up and down together, with Fagan's 'close the space down' and closing Falcao; no evidence of a deep low block or a gegenpressing style.

mar.personaBrief: No direct source on marking; Fagan's 'whoever was close to Falcao should close him down' implies shared zonal responsibility over a dedicated marker, and Liverpool's compact blocks fit zonal defending.

pla.personaBrief: Paisley rarely set up specifically to counter opponents and tampered little with the system, though European away games were treated differently and he reshaped the style around Dalglish.

res.personaBrief: A winning-first, pragmatic club (four European Cups, treble in 1984) that treated away European ties with care and won ugly when needed, while valuing pinpoint passing.

sis.personaBrief: Paisley denied a production-line system and bought quality players, yet a collective with set roles, everyone working, and Kennedy repositioned shows the system lifting players.

jog.personaBrief: Technically adept defenders and midfielders (Hansen, Lawrenson, Souness, Dalglish) were prized, with pace and stamina still required; Paisley wanted defenders who start attacks rather than just repel them.

bas.personaBrief: Buying relatively obscure talent (Hansen, Rush, Whelan, Nicol) and Dalglish, easing signings in on the bench, ruthlessly moving on aging stars; reliance on seasoned winners over academy products.

lid.personaBrief: Boot Room consensus with views aired freely, Fagan as an avuncular 'Uncle Joe' who also cut through meetings; Paisley ruthless with decisions, rules applied to all.
